description: Sendcloud parcel data stored on orders

sendcloud_shipment_id.description: Swell shipment created from the Sendcloud label

sendcloud_shipment_status.description: Whether the app created the Swell shipment for the parcel or found nothing left to ship (shipped elsewhere, refunded or canceled)

sendcloud_note.description: Why no Swell shipment was created for the parcel

sendcloud_invoice_id.description: Invoice this shipment is held for, when the subscription ships on its own schedule

sendcloud_status_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the latest applied Sendcloud webhook, used to skip out-of-order updates
